objects.description: During the [2026 U.S. Water Utilities Attacks](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0066), the adversary changed passwords on internet-facing MicroLogix controllers, locking out operators, and causing water and wastewater utilities to lose control of their equipment (e.g., controllers, water towers, lift stations).(Citation: Tenable Minnesota Water Utilities)(Citation: Forescout Water Systems Attack)(Citation: Dragos Water Under Attack)(Citation: FBI Water and Wastewater)
